name: gogcli-mcp-gmail
description: Extended Gmail for Claude via gogcli — auth + full Gmail support (threads, labels, drafts, attachments, forward, autoreply, bulk operations)

gog_account.title: Google Account
gog_account.description: Default Google account email (optional — uses gogcli's configured default if omitted)

gog_path.title: gog Executable Path
gog_path.description: Path to the gog executable (optional — defaults to 'gog' on your PATH)

tools.name: gog_auth_add
tools.description: Authorize a Google account via browser-based OAuth

tools.name: gog_auth_health
tools.description: Live per-account token health: validity, age, and pre-expiry warnings (detects invalid_grant)

tools.name: gog_auth_add_url
tools.description: Begin remote/headless OAuth (step 1): return a sign-in URL to open in any browser

tools.name: gog_auth_add_complete
tools.description: Complete remote/headless OAuth (step 2): exchange the pasted redirect URL and store the token

tools.name: gog_auth_list
tools.description: List all Google accounts stored in gogcli

tools.name: gog_auth_status
tools.description: Show gogcli auth configuration

tools.name: gog_auth_services
tools.description: List Google services and OAuth scopes supported by gogcli

tools.name: gog_auth_run
tools.description: Run any gog auth subcommand (escape hatch)

tools.name: gog_gmail_search
tools.description: Search Gmail threads using Gmail query syntax; newest-first, and flags a truncated result set

tools.name: gog_gmail_get
tools.description: Get a Gmail message by ID

tools.name: gog_gmail_send
tools.description: Send an email, with attachments from server-side paths (attach) or from base64 bytes sent with the call (attachInline, for remote deployments with no shared filesystem)

tools.name: gog_gmail_run
tools.description: Run any gog gmail subcommand (escape hatch)

tools.name: gog_gmail_raw
tools.description: Dump raw Gmail API JSON for a message

tools.name: gog_gmail_attachment
tools.description: Download a Gmail attachment by 0-based attachmentIndex (or legacy attachmentId) and deliver its contents: inline (base64 image/resource) when within the inline limit, otherwise uploaded to Google Drive with a shareable link

tools.name: gog_gmail_url
tools.description: Print Gmail web URLs for one or more threads

tools.name: gog_gmail_history
tools.description: List Gmail history events since a historyId

tools.name: gog_gmail_archive
tools.description: Archive messages by IDs or by query

tools.name: gog_gmail_mark_read
tools.description: Mark messages as read by IDs or by query

tools.name: gog_gmail_mark_unread
tools.description: Mark messages as unread by IDs or by query

tools.name: gog_gmail_trash
tools.description: Move messages to trash by IDs or by query

tools.name: gog_gmail_message_modify
tools.description: Modify labels on a single message

tools.name: gog_gmail_batch_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete multiple messages (irreversible; requires force:true)

tools.name: gog_gmail_batch_modify
tools.description: Modify labels on multiple messages at once

tools.name: gog_gmail_thread_get
tools.description: Get a Gmail thread with all messages — the right tool when the threadId is already known

tools.name: gog_gmail_thread_modify
tools.description: Modify labels on all messages in a thread

tools.name: gog_gmail_thread_attachments
tools.description: List or download all attachments in a thread

tools.name: gog_gmail_labels_list
tools.description: List all Gmail labels

tools.name: gog_gmail_labels_get
tools.description: Get label details and counts

tools.name: gog_gmail_labels_create
tools.description: Create a new Gmail label

tools.name: gog_gmail_labels_rename
tools.description: Rename a Gmail label

tools.name: gog_gmail_labels_delete
tools.description: Delete a Gmail label

tools.name: gog_gmail_labels_modify
tools.description: Modify labels on one or more threads

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_list
tools.description: List Gmail drafts, annotated free with origin (api / non-api) and rootsOwnThread

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_get
tools.description: Get a Gmail draft by ID

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_create
tools.description: Create a new Gmail draft, with attachments from server-side paths (attach) or from base64 bytes sent with the call (attachInline, for remote deployments with no shared filesystem)

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_update
tools.description: Update an existing Gmail draft; re-thread it in place with replyToThreadId (same draft id) and verify the result via threadingVerification; forkSiblingDraftId refuses the write when the new body would drop text the named sibling copy still holds; a 404 is attributed to the draft id or to the reply target before it is reported Attachments come from server-side paths (attach) or from base64 bytes sent with the call (attachInline, for remote deployments with no shared filesystem).

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_delete
tools.description: Delete a Gmail draft

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_send
tools.description: Send an existing Gmail draft; a 404 comes back diagnosed (DRAFT_FORKED, or GOOGLE_404_NOT_THE_DRAFT when the draft is still listed)

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_diff
tools.description: Diff two named drafts: what each body has that the other lost, how their threading differs, and (only on a link back to the original or on agreement over unquoted text, with evidence) whether one replaced the other

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_reply
tools.description: Save a reply to a Gmail message as a draft (inherited recipients, subject and quote; never sends) Attachments come from server-side paths (attach) or from base64 bytes sent with the call (attachInline, for remote deployments with no shared filesystem).

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_reply_all
tools.description: Save a reply-all to a Gmail message as a draft (never sends) Attachments come from server-side paths (attach) or from base64 bytes sent with the call (attachInline, for remote deployments with no shared filesystem).

tools.name: gog_gmail_drafts_forward
tools.description: Save a forward of a Gmail message as a draft; recipients are optional (never sends)

tools.name: gog_gmail_import
tools.description: Import an RFC822/EML message into the mailbox (keeps its original headers and date; does not send)

tools.name: gog_gmail_forward
tools.description: Forward a Gmail message to new recipients

tools.name: gog_gmail_reply
tools.description: Reply to a Gmail message (sender only) Attachments come from server-side paths (attach) or from base64 bytes sent with the call (attachInline, for remote deployments with no shared filesystem).

tools.name: gog_gmail_reply_all
tools.description: Reply to all participants of a Gmail message Attachments come from server-side paths (attach) or from base64 bytes sent with the call (attachInline, for remote deployments with no shared filesystem).

tools.name: gog_gmail_autoreply
tools.description: Reply once to all messages matching a Gmail search query

tools.name: gog_gmail_messages_search
tools.description: Search individual messages; newest-first, and flags a truncated result set

tools.name: gog_gmail_labels_style
tools.description: Change a user label's color or visibility

tools.name: gog_gmail_vacation_get
tools.description: Get the current vacation responder settings

tools.name: gog_gmail_vacation_update
tools.description: Enable, disable, or update the vacation responder

tools.name: gog_gmail_filters_list
tools.description: List all Gmail filters

tools.name: gog_gmail_filters_get
tools.description: Get a single Gmail filter's criteria and actions

tools.name: gog_gmail_filters_create
tools.description: Create a Gmail filter with match criteria and actions

tools.name: gog_gmail_filters_delete
tools.description: Delete a Gmail filter by ID

tools.name: gog_gmail_sendas_list
tools.description: List all send-as aliases for the account

tools.name: gog_gmail_sendas_get
tools.description: Get details of a single send-as alias

tools.name: gog_gmail_sendas_create
tools.description: Create a send-as alias

tools.name: gog_gmail_sendas_update
tools.description: Update a send-as alias or make it the default

tools.name: gog_gmail_sendas_delete
tools.description: Delete a send-as alias

tools.name: gog_gmail_sendas_verify
tools.description: Resend the verification email for a send-as alias
